title: Felix and the Contact
premise: Emrys Marchetti, a fixer for the unlisted embassy known only as the Annex, is pulled in when a passenger flight's records vanish mid-flight — a signature of the very operation they helped bury a year ago. Following the ghost flight leads them to a scheduled 'accident' engineered by their former handler, who has weaponized Emrys's own past mistakes as leverage. As Emrys races to stop the attack, they must choose between protecting the person they love and exposing the Annex's complicity. In the end, Emrys stops the attack but burns their old life down, choosing truth over survival and exile over silence.
about_author: Yara Okonkwo is a former aviation logistics analyst who spent six years working near diplomatic corridors before turning to fiction full-time. She writes thrillers about people trapped between institutions and their own consciences.

chapters.title: Ghost Altitude
chapters.summary: Emrys Marchetti's POV. A routine night at the Annex shatters when Flight 447's transponder data, manifests, and booking records evaporate while the plane is still airborne. Emrys recognizes the deletion pattern — it matches an operation they buried a year ago, the one that cost them their sleep. The emotional beat: dread reawakened; the past isn't past.

chapters.title: The Handler's Ledger
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Emrys and their partner Ilse, a commercial pilot. Emrys traces the vanished flight to Voss, their former handler, who contacts them with proof of Emrys's role in last year's cover-up: cooperate, or the record goes public. Meanwhile Ilse is assigned to a charter route that fits the attack profile exactly. The beat: love and duty begin pulling apart.

chapters.title: Countdown Over Water
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV, compressed into one desperate day. They infiltrate the Annex's archive, confirm the attack is staged for tomorrow's charter flight, and discover the Annex leadership already knows — and will let it happen. Voss corners Emrys with an ultimatum as Ilse boards her assigned aircraft unaware. The beat: betrayal on every side; the clock runs out.

chapters.title: What Survives the Fall
chapters.summary: Climax and resolution, split POV. Emrys grounds Ilse's flight by triggering the very scandal Voss held over them, sacrificing their leverage and freedom. Voss is arrested by the Annex's own auditors; the attack collapses. Emrys walks out of the embassy that doesn't exist, hand in hand with Ilse, into a smaller, truer life. The beat: survival redefined as what you refuse to carry.
